newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kopper to comment on Daimler post in due course.
newsitem.headline: Kopper to comment on Daimler post in due course.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG Chairman Hilmar Kopper said on Friday he would be making an announcement on his tenure as chairman of Daimler Benz AG's supervisory board "in due course".
"I have a position there for a number of years," Kopper told Reuters at the Frankfurt European Banking Congress.
"I will make an announcement about my position in due time."
Kopper is scheduled to leave his position as chairman of Deutsche Bank in May next year, a post which also has historically carried with it the leadership of Daimler's supervisory board.
A Daimler Benz spokesman said that Kopper's position on the supervisory board is scheduled to last until the end of 1998.
